name: Natural-Language Harness Runtime
description: Inspectable NLAH.md policy documents mapped to deterministic AIWG mechanisms and ablation reports.
author: AIWG Contributors

cli_commands.description: Validate, plan, and ablate inspectable NLAH.md harness documents

validate.description: Validate an NLAH.md document and its deterministic execution map

plan.description: Render the deterministic execution plan without executing it

ablate.description: Remove one named module and report the resulting plan delta
